binding.method: Screened positive rest-graph smoothing of only the original pucker x increment, with fixed core and exterior boundary values
binding.coreRule: Union of native top.lips, all samples.rim, original pairs, and native roi with abs(u)<=1 and 0<=v<=1.05; plus exactly one full-index neighbour ring. Negative-v and oral points are ineligible for edits.
binding.exteriorRule: Same-side native type<.5, inner<=.005, v>=0, front>.25, depth<6mm; native exterior vertical region; free points exclude core and abs(u)<=.64
binding.fades: Coefficient g: u .64-.84 and 1.5-1.6; front .25-.75; depth 3.5-6mm; 1mm outer vertical fades. Domain is not cut 4mm from the lip core.

solver.method: Diagonal-preconditioned conjugate gradients on the symmetric positive-definite correction system; actual residual recomputed

binding.sourceValues: Current before-local native pucker x contribution; zero for originally inactive vertices; no posed displacement stored at install

solverScope.protectedDomainCountInterpretation: Core and center sets overlap; do not add their counts as unique protected vertices. The 49 original contact pairs are separately hashed after all native phases.
solverScope.residualInterpretation: Actual recomputed algebraic residuals of the screened graph system, not global displacement error bounds or physiological accuracy. Four millimetres is an engineering smoothing length.
solverScope.runtimeVersusOffline: Direct-delta counts and residuals are preserved actual runtime measurements from the hash-pinned module. This audit checked values and limits; it did not recompute the sparse solve without runtime mesh buffers.

originalImageReview.method: Direct original unedited PNG inspection at saved dimensions; no generated, reconstructed or retouched images.

observations.finding: Full-pucker R06 reduces the prominence of the broad bright exterior wedge below each corner.

At 75% and 100% pucker, the corrected exterior skin also has conspicuous stacked transverse ridges and angular darker hollows near the corners. This is a visual side effect despite exact contact samples and unchanged material pipeline.

No obvious new global lip-colour, gloss or lip-body change appears in the viewed pairs. Broad smooth/lipstick-like quality and the thin dark mouth seam remain; those existing limitations are not solved here.

The viewed speaking pair is visually identical, consistent with offline-rechecked complete-state and pixel equality. Sparse pucker progress frames retain their distinct action shapes; they cannot prove continuous temporal quality or absence of popping between samples.

originalImageReview.visualDeliveryRecommendation: Reject candidate-02 while retaining its technical success. The late-pucker crease/ridge tradeoff requires a separate geometry hypothesis; numerical response and unchanged material authoring do not prove improved appearance.

limitations: One immutable native person and the existing 15-test matrix; no new browser run, person, custom pose, phone or network stress test.
